title: Icons
summary: RoVR uses the Lucide icon set through lucide-react: outlined icons at a 1.5 stroke, 16px inside controls. One set for both apps.

demos.title: The library
demos.note: One icon set across the patient app and the provider app, so a calendar or a pill looks the same everywhere.

c.name: package. Every icon is a React component
c.text: package. Every icon is a React component you import by name. Do not add a second icon set or hand-drawn SVGs for things Lucide already has.

c.name: li: Words first Every action is a wo
Every action is a worded button. An icon
c.text: Every action is a worded button. An icon supports the label; it replaces it only in tight toolbars, with an aria-label and a tooltip.

c.name: li: One meaning per icon CalendarDay
CalendarDays is always an appointment an
c.text: CalendarDays is always an appointment and Pill is always a medication. Do not reuse an icon for a second idea.

c.name: li: No tinted squares An icon stands
An icon stands on its own or not at all.
c.text: An icon stands on its own or not at all. Do not put it inside a coloured rounded box.

c.name: li: Decorative icons are hidden Luci
Lucide icons are aria-hidden by default.
c.text: Lucide icons are aria-hidden by default. Give meaning with text beside them, not with the icon alone.

c.name: li: No emoji Emoji render differentl
Emoji render differently on every device
c.text: Emoji render differently on every device. Use an icon or plain words.

c.name: li: Brand marks are not icons Logos
Logos for Apple Health, insurers or labs
c.text: Logos for Apple Health, insurers or labs come from those companies' own assets, not from Lucide.
